lines.text: The king of Egypt dethroned Jehoahaz, made his brother Eliakim king as Jehoiakim, and carried Jehoahaz off to Egypt.
Jehoiakim reigned eleven years and did evil, and Nebuchadnezzar bound him with bronze shackles and took articles to Babylon.
Jehoiachin reigned three months and ten days, then Neco summoned him and made Zedekiah king.
The Chaldeans burned the house of God, and the land rested seventy years as Isaiah foretold.
The LORD stirred Cyrus king of Persia to proclaim that the LORD appointed him to build a house at Jerusalem.
